decisions.reason: Although sports flooring is less central than the firm's style-led residential focus, this system extends an established technical offer and can still serve institutional projects.
Arena-focused mobile flooring is a narrow, event-dependent niche outside the firm's stated direction, so it is a likely target for portfolio pruning.
A second mobile arena floor line appears overlapping in a peripheral segment, making rationalization of the range likely.
Chevron hardwood parquet is close to the core premium flooring business, was presented as a flagship, and fits the firm's trend-led natural interior strategy.
A squash-specific surface finish is a small specialist item in a non-core sports niche and is less likely to justify ongoing focus than mainstream flooring lines.
As a simple accessory linked to existing sports-floor installations, oak skirting is relatively low-cost to retain even if sports products are not the main strategic priority.
